# Fai Refriandi

> Portfolio of Fai Refriandi, a Fullstack & Android Mobile Developer based in Bandung, Indonesia. He works at Flowzup Studio and builds web and mobile products.

## About

Fai Refriandi is a Fullstack & Android Mobile Developer based in Bandung, Indonesia. He works at Flowzup Studio, where he works on Guepedia, and builds web and mobile products. This portfolio is a single page with an about section, social links, a live GitHub contribution graph, and selected projects.
